description: Deep link into the live charter search results for a destination, date, party and optional trip length — hand this URL to the user to see live availability and book. Children are ages 0-14 at departure; ages 15+ count as adults. Pure URL builder (no data).

children_ages.description: Age of each child AT DEPARTURE (0-14 = child; 15+ is counted as an adult automatically).

nights.description: Trip length in nights. Omit for the standard charter length (6 nights / 7 days). Most departures also sell 3-10 nights.
